title: TEHRAN - Oct 18, Hamidreza Hajibabaei, the Deputy Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, made remarks in an interview at Iran's parliament.
text:
TEHRAN - Oct 18, Hamidreza Hajibabaei, the Deputy Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, made remarks in an interview at Iran's parliament."

"-----"

"SOT, Hamidreza Hajibabaei, the Deputy Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi): "The presence of the Speaker of the Parliament [Ghalibaf] at the first session, given the current circumstances, as well as the vote actually cast by the members of Parliament, indicated that today, instead of taking action and demonstrating the power to stand against the nation of Iran and its armed forces, America has chosen slogans. We have instilled in our own minds all types of American bombs, and we have a plan for them: if they want to bring "mother bombs," we will send "father missiles" after them.”
